label.en: Detecting iron(III) ions with potassium thiocyanate

label.zh: 铁离子与亚铁离子的相互转化
label.en: Interconversion of iron(III) and iron(II) ions

label.zh: 浓度对铁离子—硫氰酸根平衡的影响
label.en: Concentration effects on the iron–thiocyanate equilibrium

cues.title: 红色在报告什么？
cues.caption: 同一检验条件下，红色报告含Fe³⁺的配合物。
cues.captionEn: Under the same test conditions, red reports Fe³⁺ complexes.
cues.zh: 两管都有铁，加入同一种试剂，却只有一管显红色。放大这份溶液：硫氰酸根与三价铁结合，形成能显红色的配合物；二价铁对照没有相同的响应。现在把两种铁离子放在同一份样品里，先猜它会不会变红。红色仍然出现，二价铁也仍在水里。所以这个检验报告三价铁的存在，不能据此说样品里只有三价铁。
cues.en: Both tubes contain iron, yet the same reagent turns only one red. Look closer: thiocyanate binds iron(III), forming coloured complexes. The iron(II) control lacks that response. Now predict the result when both ions share one sample. It still turns red, and the iron(II) remains. Under these test conditions, red indicates iron(III); it does not establish that every iron ion is iron(III).

cues.title: 多出来的亚铁来自哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where does the extra iron(II) come from?
cues.caption: 一份金属铁给出两个电子，自己也进入溶液。
cues.captionEn: One iron atom supplies two electrons and joins the solution.
cues.zh: 先看铁粉与三价铁反应，这时还没有加入检验试剂。跟住这一个金属铁：它给出的两个电子，分别记到两个三价铁上。原来的两个离子成为二价铁，给出电子的金属铁自己也成为二价铁。于是水里多出一份铁，总共是三份，不是两份。再做硫氰酸根检验，红色没有出现。消失的是三价铁的显色响应，铁并没有从水中消失。
cues.en: First let iron powder react with iron(III), before adding the test reagent. Follow one metal atom. Its two donated electrons are credited to two iron(III) ions. Those ions become iron(II), and the metal atom also enters solution as iron(II). That makes three dissolved iron units, not two. The subsequent thiocyanate test gives no red response. Iron has not vanished; its oxidation state has changed.

cues.title: 为什么要留下铁粉？
cues.titleEn: Why leave the iron powder behind?
cues.caption: 清液移走，未反应的电子供体留在原管。
cues.captionEn: The liquid moves; the remaining electron donor stays behind.
cues.zh: 三个标记过的铁离子随清液进入另一管，底部没反应完的铁粉留下。移取没有改变这些离子的价态，却拿走了一个潜在的电子供体。想一想，如果剩余铁粉也跟过去，下一步的氧化剂就可能接收它给出的电子，或者新生成的三价铁又被还原。分开固体，是让后面的颜色更能说明清液中铁离子的变化。
cues.en: The three marked ions travel with the clear liquid, while unused metal stays behind. Moving the liquid does not change their oxidation state. It removes a possible electron donor. If metal came along, it could consume oxidizing capacity or reduce newly formed iron(III) again. Leaving the powder behind makes the next colour response easier to attribute to changes in the dissolved iron.

cues.title: 电子这次去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where do the electrons go now?
cues.caption: Fe²⁺给出电子；氯接收，配体重新结合。
cues.captionEn: Fe²⁺ donates electrons; chlorine accepts; ligands bind again.
cues.zh: 在分开的清液中，电子这次从二价铁移到氯。两份二价铁各给出一个电子，成为三价铁；一份氯分子接收两个电子，成为两个氯离子。先前留在水里的硫氰酸根重新参与配位，红色回来。再比较一个限量的净账本：同样的氧化剂，如果管里还留下金属铁，它的电子也能消耗这份氧化能力。仅仅加入氧化剂，并不保证得到相同的红色结果。
cues.en: In the separated liquid, electrons are now credited from iron(II) to chlorine. Two iron(II) ions each lose one electron; one chlorine molecule accepts two, yielding two chloride ions. The restored iron(III) binds thiocyanate already in the water, and red returns. Now compare a limited-dose account with leftover metal. Its electrons can consume the same oxidizing capacity. Adding an oxidant alone does not guarantee the same colour result.

cues.title: 红色稳定，粒子就停了吗？
cues.titleEn: Does steady colour mean particles have stopped?
cues.caption: 配体不断交换，平衡时各物种的比例稳定。
cues.captionEn: Ligands exchange while equilibrium proportions remain steady.
cues.zh: 三管来自同一份红色溶液，先把没有改动的一管留下作参照。放大里面的一小部分：有些硫氰酸根连在铁上，有些仍游离在水中。跟住其中一份，它可以离开，也可以重新结合。平衡时不是粒子停止交换，而是两边相互转化，没有净变化。接下来改变其中一边，看看为什么原来的配体分配不再保持。
cues.en: The three tubes begin with the same red solution. Keep one unchanged. Inside, some thiocyanate is bound to iron and some remains free. Follow one ligand as it leaves and another binds. Equilibrium does not mean these exchanges stop. Forward and reverse changes balance, leaving no net change in the proportions. Alter one part of this mixture and the original distribution need not persist.

cues.title: 红色变浅，配体去哪了？
cues.titleEn: Where do the ligands go as red fades?
cues.caption: Fe³⁺被还原，配体从配合物回到水中。
cues.captionEn: As Fe³⁺ is reduced, ligands return to the water.
cues.zh: 加入铁粉的这一管，先有一部分游离三价铁得到电子，变成二价铁。原来的配合物还在，自由三价铁却减少了，于是画出的第一步配位，浓度商高于平衡常数。跟住标记的配体：一份配合物解离，它回到水里，释放的三价铁补充了自由部分。重新分配后，有色物种总量减少。配体没有被铁粉吃掉，铁也没有凭空消失，只是重新分配到了不同状态。
cues.en: Iron powder first reduces some unbound iron(III). Complexes initially remain, but less free iron(III) makes the first-step formation quotient exceed its equilibrium value. Follow the marked ligand: a complex dissociates, returning the ligand to water and replenishing free iron(III). Redistribution lowers the total coloured population. The ligand has not been consumed by the powder, and iron has not vanished. Their distribution has changed.

cues.title: 红色加深，铁也增加了吗？
cues.titleEn: Does deeper red mean more iron?
cues.caption: 跟住新配体，看分配如何改变。
cues.captionEn: Follow the added ligand as the mixture redistributes.
cues.zh: 另一管只增加硫氰酸根。新配体先进入自由部分，这时配合物还没增加，浓度商低于原来的平衡值。随后，标记的配体进入铁的配位环境，更多铁进入有色物种。先猜：铁的总量会不会随颜色一起增加？账本没有增加一份铁，只有自由和结合的分配改变了。红色深浅取决于条件，不能脱离配体条件，直接当成铁总量的刻度。
cues.en: The other tube receives more thiocyanate. Free ligand rises before additional complexes form, lowering the formation quotient. The marked ligand then binds, shifting more iron into coloured species. Predict whether the total iron also increases. It does not: the iron account stays fixed while its distribution changes. Colour depends on the ligand conditions, so deeper red is not automatically a measure of more total iron.

cues.title: 配位为什么不是还原？
cues.caption: 跟住配体与共享的成键电子对。
cues.captionEn: Follow the ligand and its shared bonding pair.
cues.zh: 最后只跟住一个三价铁和一份配体。水中的铁本来就有配位环境；硫氰酸根通过氮这一端参与配位，一份水离开。画出的电子对属于配位键的成键表示，不会像前面的还原那样，把铁的形式氧化数从正三改成正二。一个负一价配体加入后，配离子的总电荷从正三变成正二，铁的形式氧化数却仍是正三。再结合第二份负配体，总电荷成为正一。电荷数字下降，不等于中心铁被还原。
cues.en: Follow one iron(III) centre and one ligand. The hydrated centre already has a coordination environment. Thiocyanate binds through nitrogen while a water ligand leaves. The bonding pair is shared; it does not turn formal iron(III) into iron(II). Adding one negatively charged ligand changes the complex charge from plus three to plus two, while iron remains formally plus three. A second ligand gives a plus-one complex. A lower complex charge does not mean the central iron has been reduced.

lead.zh: 先比较两种铁离子，再预测混合样品。
lead.en: Compare both iron ions, then predict a mixed sample.

principle.zh: 相同检验条件下，Fe³⁺与SCN⁻形成红色配合物；阳性响应表明含Fe³⁺，不代表所有铁都是Fe³⁺。
principle.en: Under matched test conditions, Fe³⁺ forms red thiocyanate complexes. A positive response indicates Fe³⁺ without proving all iron is Fe³⁺.

question.zh: 同时含Fe²⁺和Fe³⁺的样品显红色，能排除Fe²⁺吗？
question.en: Does a red mixed sample rule out Fe²⁺?

explanation.zh: 不能。Fe³⁺的配合物能显红色，Fe²⁺仍可同时存在。
explanation.en: No. Red Fe³⁺ complexes can coexist with Fe²⁺.

question.zh: 红色回来，电子去了哪里？
question.en: Where do the electrons go when red returns?

lead.zh: 追踪铁粉与氯的电子账，再比较残留铁粉。
lead.en: Follow the metal and chlorine electron accounts, then test leftover metal.

principle.zh: 铁粉给电子还原Fe³⁺，氯接电子氧化Fe²⁺；分离剩余铁粉去掉竞争供体，已有SCN⁻报告恢复的Fe³⁺。
principle.en: Metal supplies electrons to reduce Fe³⁺; chlorine accepts electrons from Fe²⁺. Removing leftover metal removes a competing donor, and existing SCN⁻ reports restored Fe³⁺.

question.zh: 同样少量氧化剂，有剩余铁粉时一定得到相同红色吗？
question.en: Must the same limited oxidant dose give the same red response with leftover metal?

explanation.zh: 不一定。剩余金属也能消耗氧化能力，或还原新生Fe³⁺；结果还取决于各反应物的量与条件。
explanation.en: No. Metal can consume oxidizing capacity or reduce restored Fe³⁺. Reagent amounts and conditions also matter.

question.zh: 红色变深，铁也变多了吗？
question.en: Does deeper red mean more iron?

lead.zh: 跟住游离与结合的配体，看三管如何从同一起点分开。
lead.en: Follow free and bound ligands as three matching samples diverge.

principle.zh: 改变自由Fe³⁺或SCN⁻先改变浓度商，再通过配体解离与结合改变物种分配；增加配体可加深红色而不增加铁总量。
principle.en: Changing free Fe³⁺ or SCN⁻ changes the quotient, then binding and dissociation redistribute species. More ligand can deepen red without adding iron.

question.zh: 只加KSCN后红色加深，哪一个总量必须保持不变？
question.en: After adding only KSCN, which total must remain unchanged?

explanation.zh: 铁的总量不变；配体总量增加，自由与结合铁的比例可改变。
explanation.en: Total iron stays fixed. Total ligand increases, allowing the free/bound iron distribution to change.

question.zh: 配离子电荷变小，铁被还原了吗？
question.en: Does a lower complex charge mean iron was reduced?

lead.zh: 追一份配体和成键电子对，分清整个配离子与中心铁。
lead.en: Follow one ligand and its bonding pair; separate complex charge from iron oxidation state.

principle.zh: SCN⁻参与配位后改变整个配离子的电荷，Fe形式氧化数仍为+3；配位键共享电子对不能等同于氧化还原得电子。
principle.en: SCN⁻ changes the charge of the whole complex while iron remains formally +3. A shared coordination pair is not the redox assignment of an electron to iron.

question.zh: 简写[Fe(SCN)₂]⁺的电荷为+1，Fe的形式氧化数是多少？
question.en: If abbreviated [Fe(SCN)₂]⁺ has charge+1, what is iron’s formal oxidation state?

explanation.zh: +3，因为两个SCN⁻共为−2，中心铁的+3与它们相加为+1。水配体在简写中省略。
explanation.en: +3. Two SCN⁻ ligands contribute−2; together with+3 on iron the complex has charge+1. Water ligands are omitted in the shorthand.

title.zh: 同样的铁，为什么红色会消失又回来？
title.en: Why can iron lose its red response and regain it?

description.zh: 追踪铁与氯的电子收支、配体的解离与重组，分清显色、氧化还原与配合平衡。
description.en: Follow electron accounts and ligand regrouping to distinguish colour evidence, redox and coordination equilibrium.

tag.zh: 电子收支 · 配体重组 · 显色证据
tag.en: Electron accounts · Ligand exchange · Colour evidence

translations.计量单位，不是实测粒子数: Stoichiometric units, not measured particle counts
translations.混合样品：等待显色检验: Mixed sample: predict the test result
translations.三价铁结合硫氰酸根，二价铁仍留在溶液中: Iron(III) binds thiocyanate; iron(II) remains in solution
translations.电子份额记账；包含转移中的电子，同一铁和氯身份保持: Electron-credit account, including credits in transit. Iron and chlorine identities persist.
translations.三个标记离子随清液移动；金属铁留在原管: Three tagged ions move with the clear aliquot; metal stays in the original tube
translations.限量氧化剂的两种净账本；不表示反应先后或速率: Two limited-oxidant net accounts, not an elementary reaction order or rate
translations.同量氧化剂，有无剩余金属铁，先预测: Same oxidant dose, with or without metal: predict first
translations.显色一定相同吗？: Must the colour be the same?
translations.三份同源溶液，a保留参照: Three matched samples; a is kept unchanged
translations.选定的成对交换：一份配体离开，另一份结合；总体分布稳定: Selected paired exchanges: one ligand leaves while another binds; the overall distribution is steady
translations.局部交换 · 不是速率模型: Selected exchange · not a rate law
translations.预测：配体增加后，铁总量会增加吗？: Predict: does adding ligand increase total iron?
translations.自由与结合的硫氰酸根来自同一物料账本；数值为理想示例: Free and bound thiocyanate share one material account; numbers are an ideal example
translations.配离子总电荷为正二，中心铁的形式氧化数是多少？: Complex charge is plus two. What is the central iron oxidation state?
translations.氮端配位，水配体离开；中心铁形式氧化数始终正三: Nitrogen binds as a water ligand leaves; the central iron remains formally plus three
translations.金色点是电子份额的记账，不是水中自由电子的飞行。微观对象是选定事件，不是一颗代表: Gold dots are electron credits, not free electrons flying through water. Microscopic objects depict selected events, not fixed mole-count markers. The ideal two-complex model uses 25 °C constants; hydration, activities and Fe(II) complexation are not fully represented. Colour is not measured absorbance.
translations.平衡镜头先作有限扰动，再用守恒的组成路径连接新平衡；时间不代表真实速率。这里的初: Equilibrium shots apply a finite perturbation and a conservative compositional path to a new equilibrium, not a kinetic prediction. The illustrative initial concentrations are 2.5 mmol/L Fe(III) and 1 mmol/L SCN⁻, distinct from the textbook recipe and drop volume.

scientificBoundaries: Fixed textbook observations are separate from illustrative model concentrations, colours and timings. Do not create a measured RGB/spectrum/rate dataset.

Published zero-ionic-strength constants are used only in an ideal activity≈concentration teaching limit at25°C. Real acidic sample hydrolysis, chloride competition, activities and long-time SCN redox are omitted; do not describe the numerical mixture as the exact textbook sample.

Keep textbook Fe(SCN)3 shorthand visible on demand alongside the more detailed mono/bis convention. FeIII in the model means the unbound-to-SCN hydrated pool, not naked ions. A one-SCN or two-SCN formula does not mean iron has coordination number1or2.
Local N-end/water-exchange geometry is a topology illustration; not crystallographic coordinates, not a unique chloride-medium stereoisomer, and not a measured substitution mechanism or rate.

Redox dots are persistent electron bookkeeping tokens, not solvated electrons flying through the liquid. Charges include in-transit credits. Shared coordination-pair dots stay in the bond representation and never change Fe formalIII.
At full ideal reduction, dissolved Fe increases by metal contribution; FeIII loss is not iron removal. Equilibrium removal therefore retains FeII and consumed-metal accounts.
SCN free+mono+2bis and all-phase iron totals must hold during perturbation and visual redistribution, not only at endpoints. Adding KSCN includes its K+ in the spectator charge account.

A prescribed depletion of freeFeIII is an explanatory perturbation, not a claim that all physical reduction exclusively attacks free aquo ions before any complex. Conservative interpolation is not kinetic integration.
Individual complex species need not all decrease when FeIII falls: prepared counterexample shows a small bis increase as freeSCN rises while totalcomplex decreases.

Leftover-metal comparison is an explicit limited-dose net-account counterexample, not universal reaction ordering, measured kinetics or a promise about arbitrary excesschlorine. Chlorine also has other solution reactions outside the model.
A red response does not prove all iron isFeIII; absent visible red is not a universal zeroFeIII measurement or diagnostic claim. Matched textbook test conditions are essential.
Water/electrolytes may be omitted from local composition shorthand but cannot silently disappear from any displayed quantitative atom/charge ledger.
FeII lacks the same red response under the textbook test; this model omits FeII–SCN coordination. Never claim FeII cannot coordinate SCN at all.
